periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique axis tilted approximately 60 degrees from the horizontal, tapering inward towards the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a vertical-to-horizontal ratio of approximately 2:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward extension where the inferior margin is elongated further from the ocular center than the superior margin.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped curve along the posterior boundary with minimal indentation at the spinal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The band occupies approximately 35% of the visible torso length from the neck to the mid-back.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation, approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, continuous semicircular curvature at the dorsal apex of both ears.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-yellow gradient or staining in the white pelage of the posterior lumbar and hindquarter regions.
